summary: Layer 1B expansion for the ABF substrate / advanced interconnect node found one US-listed reference OSAT anchor and three underfollowed or shadow candidates tied to adjacent chokepoints: advanced PCB production, inspection/metrology gates, and reflow/thermal equipment for advanced packaging. The strongest direct public-market fit in the US-listed universe is TTMI for advanced PCBs/interconnect in AI data-center hardware. CAMT and ASYS are less direct but plausibly exposed to capacity/qualification gates in advanced packaging and substrate-adjacent manufacturing. AMKR is included as a reference context anchor rather than the main underfollowed target. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
